# Victoria 3 Lite: patched copies of two vanilla AI strategy values. Generated by tools/gen_vanilla_overrides.py; do not edit by hand.
# INJECT appends these to ai_strategy_default after vanilla's own definitions. The wiki does not say whether a
# duplicate value block overrides vanilla's or is ignored; check with the script profiler that these lines
# appear and vanilla's 00_default_strategy.txt lines for the same values do not. If vanilla's still appear,
# replace ai_strategy_default as a whole instead (REPLACE:).

INJECT:ai_strategy_default = {
	strategic_region_scores = {
		value = 0

		# Victoria 3 Lite: minor powers ignore regions they do not touch (their stances there are always none)
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_rank <= rank_value:minor_power
				NOT = { any_scope_state = { region = scope:region } }
				NOT = { any_neighbouring_state = { region = scope:region } }
			}
			add = 0
		}
		else = {
		if = { #The Far East agenda needs a dominant interest in Northeast Asia
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_tp_tsar_heir_of_alexander
				NOT = { has_variable = je_tp_tsar_heir_of_alexander_button_1_complete }
				sr:region_northeast_asia ?= scope:region
			}
			add = 500
		}

		# Base Value
		add = {
			value = 100

			add = {
				scope:region = {
					add = gdp
				}
				divide = 40000
				max = 50
			}

			every_rival_country = {
				limit = {
					has_strategic_region_interest_tier = {
						strategic_region = scope:region
						value >= 1
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}

			if = { # Victoria 3 Lite: with one culture every state is a homeland, so this only measured region size
				limit = { NOT = { has_game_rule = vl_one_culture } }
				scope:region = { every_scope_state = { limit = { is_homeland_of_country_cultures = root } add = 10 } }
			}
		}

		# We care about the things happening at home
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					region = scope:region
				}
			}
			add = 50

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:region = {
						any_scope_state = {
							owner = root
							is_incorporated = yes
						}
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:region = capital.region
				}
				add = 100
			}
		}

		# Certain Great Powers care about Egyptian-Ottoman conflict in the early game
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = c:TUR
				exists = c:EGY
				OR = {
					has_variable = veiled_protectorate_support_ottomans
					has_variable = veiled_protectorate_support_egypt
				}
				OR = {
					carrying_capacity >= 10
					is_adjacent_to_country = c:TUR
					is_adjacent_to_country = c:EGY
				}
				scope:region = {
					OR = {
						this = sr:region_near_east
						this = sr:region_arabia
						this = sr:region_nile_basin
						this = sr:region_balkans
					}
				}
			}
			add = 500
		}

		# Britain is participating in the Caucasian War in a certain capacity early game.
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= this
				exists = c:CIR
				country_rank = rank_value:great_power
				carrying_capacity >= 20
				scope:region = sr:region_russia
			}
			add = 100
		}

		# Annexation of Hawaii
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_variable = hawaii_interest
					c:USA ?= this
					AND = {
						has_global_variable = gp_hawaii_interest
						country_rank = rank_value:great_power
						OR = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
						}
					}
				}
				scope:region = sr:region_oceania
			}
			add = 200
		}

		# Sakoku
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = c:JAP
				c:JAP = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism }
				NOT = { country_rank = rank_value:great_power }
				scope:region = sr:region_northeast_asia
			}
			add = -50
		}

		# Scramble for Africa
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						country_rank = rank_value:great_power
						has_technology_researched = malaria_prevention
					}
					has_journal_entry = je_scramble_for_africa
				}
				scope:region = {
					OR = {
						this = sr:region_nile_basin
						this = sr:region_north_africa
						this = sr:region_west_africa
						this = sr:region_equatorial_africa
						this = sr:region_southern_africa
						this = sr:region_east_africa
					}
				}
			}
			add = 200
		}

		# Great Powers always care about Europe somehwat
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				scope:region = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
				}
			}
			add = 50

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:region = {
						OR = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_germany_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_rhine_old
						}
					}
				}
				add = 50

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_journal_entry = je_german_unification
					}
					add = 1000
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:region = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_italy_old
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}

		# Europeans generally dont have any business in the Americas
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
				NOT = {
					any_scope_state = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_americas
					}
				}
				scope:region = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_americas
				}
			}

			# Unless they do!
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_aberdeen_act
				}
				add = 200

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:region = sr:region_brazil
					}

					add = 300
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = -100
			}
		}

		if = { # GBR and RUS care about Afghanistan believe it or not
			limit = {
				OR = {
					c:GBR ?= this
					c:RUS ?= this
				}
				country_rank = rank_value:great_power
				scope:region = sr:region_greater_persia
			}
			add = 500
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_arabia
			}
			if = {
				limit = { # Certain Great Powers care about Egyptian-Ottoman conflict in the early game
					OR = {
						has_variable = veiled_protectorate_support_ottomans
						has_variable = veiled_protectorate_support_egypt
					}
					OR = {
						carrying_capacity >= 10
						is_adjacent_to_country = c:TUR
						is_adjacent_to_country = c:EGY
					}
				}
				add = 1000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_oceania
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_variable = hawaii_interest
						AND = {
							exists = c:USA
							c:USA ?= THIS
						}
						AND = {
							has_global_variable = gp_hawaii_interest
							country_rank = rank_value:great_power
							OR = {
								is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
								is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_nile_basin
			}
			if = {
				limit = { # Certain Great Powers care about Egyptian-Ottoman conflict in the early game
					OR = {
						has_variable = veiled_protectorate_support_ottomans
						has_variable = veiled_protectorate_support_egypt
					}
					OR = {
						carrying_capacity >= 10
						is_adjacent_to_country = c:TUR
						is_adjacent_to_country = c:EGY
					}
				}
				add = 1000
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							country_rank = rank_value:great_power
							has_technology_researched = malaria_prevention
						}
						has_journal_entry = je_scramble_for_africa
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_north_africa
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							country_rank = rank_value:great_power
							has_technology_researched = malaria_prevention
						}
						has_journal_entry = je_scramble_for_africa
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_west_africa
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							country_rank = rank_value:great_power
							has_technology_researched = malaria_prevention
						}
						has_journal_entry = je_scramble_for_africa
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_equatorial_africa
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							country_rank = rank_value:great_power
							has_technology_researched = malaria_prevention
						}
						has_journal_entry = je_scramble_for_africa
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_southern_africa
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							country_rank = rank_value:great_power
							has_technology_researched = malaria_prevention
						}
						has_journal_entry = je_scramble_for_africa
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_east_africa
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							country_rank = rank_value:great_power
							has_technology_researched = malaria_prevention
						}
						has_journal_entry = je_scramble_for_africa
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_central_europe
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				}
				add = 100
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_german_unification
				}
				add = 1000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_southern_europe
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				}
				add = 100
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_northern_europe
			}
			if = { # Prussia should have an interest in Scandinavia
				limit = {
					wants_to_solve_schleswig_holstein = yes
				}
				add = 250
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = sr:region_balkans
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				}
				add = 50
			}
			if = { # Russia cares more than anyone else
				limit = {
					c:RUS ?= this
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				}
				add = 500
			}
		}

		# Europeans in China
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
				country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
				carrying_capacity >= 10
				scope:region = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_china
				}
			}
			add = 50

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_opium_wars
					scope:region = sr:region_south_china
				}
				add = 5000
			}
		}

		# Monroe Doctrine
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = monroe_doctrine
				scope:region = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_americas
				}
			}
			add = 100

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:region = sr:region_pacific_coast
				}
				add = 900
			}
		}

		# Conquest of Algeria
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_conquest_of_algeria
				scope:region = sr:region_north_africa
			}
			add = 1000
		}

		# Ensure we maintain interests in colonies
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:region = {
					any_scope_state = {
						is_under_colonization = yes
						owner = root
					}
				}
			}
			add = 1000
		}
		} # Victoria 3 Lite: end of else
	}

	strategic_region_stance_type_scores = {
		stance_conquer_region = {
			value = 0

			# Victoria 3 Lite: vanilla's small-country multiply-by-0 moved up front
			if = {
				limit = { NAND = { country_rank <= rank_value:minor_power scope:target_region != capital.region } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_region = {
						any_scope_country = {
							NOR = {
								this = root
								is_subject_of = root
							}
						}
					}
				}

				add = {
					desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_BASE_VALUE"
					value = 100
				}

				add = {
					desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_NUMBER_OF_CLAIMS"
					scope:target_region = {
						every_scope_state = {
							limit = {
								owner = {
									NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized }
								}
								has_claim_by = root
							}
							add = 100
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						is_country_type = unrecognized
						scope:target_region = {
							this = root.capital.region
						}
					}
					add = {
						desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_CAPITAL_REGION"
						value = 150
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:target_region = {
							this = sr:region_northeast_asia
						}
					}

					if = {
						limit = {
							country_rank = rank_value:great_power
							carrying_capacity >= 10
							has_technology_researched = nationalism
							c:JAP ?= {
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism
							}
						}
						add = {
							desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_WANTS_TO_OPEN_UP_JAPAN"
							value = 5000
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:target_region = {
							this = sr:region_western_europe
						}
					}

					if = {
						limit = {
							has_strategy = ai_strategy_restore_natural_borders
						}
						add = {
							desc = "ai_strategy_restore_natural_borders"
							add = 1000
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_territorial_expansion
					}
					multiply = {
						desc = "ai_strategy_territorial_expansion"
						value = 3
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
						liberty_desire <= 25
					}
					multiply = {
						desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_IS_LOYAL_SUBJECT"
						value = 0.5
					}
				}
			}
			}
		}

		stance_protect_region = {
			value = 0

			# Victoria 3 Lite: vanilla's small-country multiply-by-0 moved up front
			if = {
				limit = { NAND = { country_rank <= rank_value:minor_power scope:target_region != capital.region } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_region = {
						any_scope_country = {
							NOT = {
								this = root
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_BASE_VALUE"
					value = 100
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:target_region = {
							this = root.capital.region
						}
					}
					add = {
						desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_CAPITAL_REGION"
						value = 100
					}
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_aberdeen_act
					scope:target_region = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_americas
					}
				}

				add = {
					desc = "je_aberdeen_act"
					value = 200

					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:target_region = sr:region_brazil
						}

						add = 300
					}
				}
			}
			}
		}

		stance_colonize_region = {
			value = 0

			# Victoria 3 Lite: vanilla's small-country multiply-by-0 moved up front
			if = {
				limit = { NAND = { country_rank <= rank_value:minor_power scope:target_region != capital.region } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_technology_researched = colonization
					NOR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_colonial_affairs
						is_country_type = unrecognized
					}
					OR = {
						any_neighbouring_state = {
							region = scope:target_region
						}
						navy_size >= 50
					}
					scope:target_region = {
						any_scope_state = {
							owner = {
								OR = {
									is_country_type = unrecognized
									is_country_type = decentralized
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}

				add = {
					desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_BASE_VALUE"
					value = 100
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						country_is_colonial_or_company = yes
					}
					add =  {
						desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_COLONIAL_COUNTRY"
						value = 200
					}
				}

				scope:target_region = {
					every_scope_state = {
						limit = {
							owner = {
								OR = {
									is_country_type = unrecognized
									is_country_type = decentralized
								}
							}
						}
						add = {
							desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_FREE_REAL_ESTATE"
							value = 200
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_colonial_expansion
					}
					multiply = {
						desc = "ai_strategy_colonial_expansion"
						value = 3
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_technology_researched = civilizing_mission
					}
					multiply = {
						desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_CIVILIZING_MISSION_RESEARCHED"
						value = 5
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						has_technology_researched = quinine
					}
					multiply = {
						desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_QUININE_RESEARCHED"
						value = 2.5
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_journal_entry = je_scramble_for_africa
						scope:target_region = {
							OR = {
								this = sr:region_nile_basin
								this = sr:region_north_africa
								this = sr:region_west_africa
								this = sr:region_equatorial_africa
								this = sr:region_southern_africa
								this = sr:region_east_africa
							}
						}
					}
					multiply = {
						desc = "je_scramble_for_africa"
						value = 10
					}
				}
			}
			}
		}

		stance_none = {
			value = 0

			add = {
				desc = "AI_REGION_STANCE_BASE_VALUE"
				value = 100
				subtract = scope:region_score
				min = 1
			}
		}
	}

	state_value = {
		value = 0

		if = { # For our countries states
			limit = {
				scope:target_state = { owner = root }
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "STATE_VALUE_BASE_DESIRE"
			}

			add = {
				value = scope:target_state.state_population
				divide = 100000
				max = 30
				desc = "STATE_VALUE_POPULATION"
			}

			add = {
				value = scope:target_state.gdp
				divide = 100000
				max = 30
				desc = "STATE_VALUE_GDP"
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = { ai_can_incorporate_state = yes }
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_CAN_INCORPORATE"
				}
			}

			if = { # Important Straits
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = {
						state_region = { is_important_strait_state_region = yes }
						has_any_potential_strait_province = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 200
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_CONTROLS_STRAIT"
				}
			}
			else_if = { # Lesser Straits
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = {
						has_any_potential_strait_province = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_CONTROLS_STRAIT"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = { scope:target_state = { is_treaty_port = yes } }
				add = {
					value = 20
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_TREATY_PORT"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								root = {
									has_technology_researched = rubber_mastication
								}
								"num_potential_resources(bt:building_rubber_plantation)" > 0
							}
							AND = {
								root = {
									has_technology_researched = pumpjacks
								}
								"num_potential_resources(bt:building_oil_rig)" > 0
							}
							"num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_field)" > 0
							"num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_mine)" > 0
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					add = 1
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_technology_researched = rubber_mastication
							"scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_rubber_plantation)" > 0
						}
						add = {
							value = "scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_rubber_plantation)"
							divide = 100
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_technology_researched = pumpjacks
							"scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_oil_rig)" > 0
						}
						add = {
							value = "scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_oil_rig)"
							divide = 100
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							"scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_field)" > 0
						}
						add = {
							value = "scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_field)"
							divide = 100
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							"scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_mine)" > 0
						}
						add = {
							value = "scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_mine)"
							divide = 100
						}
					}
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_VALUABLE_RESOURCE_POTENTIAL"
				}
			}

			if = { # Very reluctant to cede incorporated states
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							is_incorporated = yes
							ai_can_incorporate_state = yes
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:target_state = { is_homeland_of_country_cultures = root }
					}
					multiply = {
						value = 8.0
						desc = "STATE_VALUE_INCORPORATED_HOMELAND_RELUCTANCE"
					}
				}
				else = {
					multiply = {
						value = 6.0
						desc = "STATE_VALUE_INCORPORATED_RELUCTANCE"
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = { # Reluctant to cede states adjacent or sea adjacent to incorporate states
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							any_neighbouring_state = {
								owner = root
								is_incorporated = yes
							}
							any_sea_node_adjacent_state = {
								owner = root
								is_incorporated = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:target_state = { is_homeland_of_country_cultures = root }
					}
					multiply = {
						value = 6.0
						desc = "STATE_VALUE_NEXT_TO_INCORPORATED_HOMELAND"
					}
				}
				else = {
					multiply = {
						value = 4.0
						desc = "STATE_VALUE_NEXT_TO_INCORPORATED"
					}
				}
			}
			else = { # Value owned states higher than foreign states by default
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:target_state = { is_homeland_of_country_cultures = root }
					}
					multiply = {
						value = 3.0
						desc = "STATE_VALUE_OWN_HOMELAND"
					}
				}
				else = {
					multiply = {
						value = 2.0
						desc = "STATE_VALUE_OWN_STATE"
					}
				}
			}

			# Isolated states are worth less
			# Check that this isn't caused by convoy raiding through the is_at_war trigger
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_at_war = no
					scope:target_state = { is_isolated_from_market = yes }
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0.5
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_ISOLATED_FROM_MARKET"
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							any_neighbouring_state = { owner = root }
						}
					}
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						desc = "STATE_VALUE_ISOLATED_NO_NEIGHBOUR"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = { # For other countries states
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "STATE_VALUE_BASE_DESIRE"
			}

			add = {
				value = scope:target_state.state_population
				divide = 100000
				max = 15
				desc = "STATE_VALUE_POPULATION"
			}

			add = {
				value = scope:target_state.gdp
				divide = 100000
				max = 15
				desc = "STATE_VALUE_GDP"
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = { ai_can_incorporate_state = yes }
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_CAN_INCORPORATE"
				}
			}

			if = { # Important Straits
				limit = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
					navy_size >= 100
					scope:target_state = {
						state_region = { is_important_strait_state_region = yes }
						has_any_potential_strait_province = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 200
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_CONTROLS_STRAIT"
				}
			}
			else_if = { # Lesser Straits
				limit = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
					navy_size >= 100
					scope:target_state = {
						has_any_potential_strait_province = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_CONTROLS_STRAIT"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = { is_treaty_port = yes }
				}
				add = {
					value = 10
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_TREATY_PORT"
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:target_state.state_region = {
							any_scope_state = {
								owner = root
							}
						}
					}
					add = 40
				}
			}

			if = { # High-fervour AI really wants to take its homelands
				limit = {
					country_fervor_primary_culture > 10
					scope:target_state = {
						AND = { NOT = { has_game_rule = vl_one_culture } is_homeland_of_country_cultures = root }
					}
					scope:target_country = {
						NOT = {
							any_primary_culture = {
								is_primary_culture_of = root
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = country_fervor_primary_culture
					divide = 2
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_HOMELAND_FERVOR"
				}
			}

			# Strategy-specific values, move these back into their own files later
			# Maintain Balance of Power
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_strategy = ai_strategy_maintain_power_balance
					ai_state_ambition_claim = yes
				}
				add = {
					value = 20
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_MAINTAIN_POWER_BALANCE_CLAIM"
				}
			}

			# if = {
			# 	limit = {
			# 		has_strategy = ai_strategy_maintain_power_balance
			# 		ai_state_ambition_border = yes
			# 		ai_state_has_core_ambition = no
			# 	}
			# 	add = {
			# 		value = -15
			# 		desc = "STATE_VALUE_MAINTAIN_POWER_BALANCE_NO_OPPORTUNISM"
			# 	}
			# }

			# Territorial Expansion
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_strategy = ai_strategy_territorial_expansion
					ai_state_ambition_border = yes
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_TERRITORIAL_EXPANSION_BORDER"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_strategy = ai_strategy_territorial_expansion
					ai_state_ambition_homeland = yes
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_TERRITORIAL_EXPANSION_HOMELAND"
				}
			}

			# Acquire Colonies
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_strategy = ai_strategy_colonial_expansion
					ai_state_ambition_colonial = yes
				}
				add = {
					value = 30
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_COLONIAL_EXPANSION_COLONIAL_TARGET"
				}
			}

			# if = {
			# 	limit = {
			# 		has_strategy = ai_strategy_colonial_expansion
			# 		ai_state_has_core_ambition = no
			# 		scope:target_country = {
			# 			NOR = {
			# 				is_country_type = unrecognized
			# 				is_country_type = decentralized
			# 			}
			# 		}
			# 	}
			# 	add = {
			# 		value = -20
			# 		desc = "STATE_VALUE_COLONIAL_EXPANSION_RECOGNISED_OWNER"
			# 	}
			# }

			# Armed Isolationism
			# if = {
			# 	limit = {
			# 		has_strategy = ai_strategy_armed_isolationism
			# 		ai_state_has_core_ambition = no
			# 	}
			# 	add = {
			# 		value = -25
			# 		desc = "STATE_VALUE_ARMED_ISOLATIONISM_NO_AMBITION"
			# 	}
			# }

			# Economic Imperialism
			# if = {
			# 	limit = {
			# 		has_strategy = ai_strategy_economic_imperialism
			# 		ai_state_has_core_ambition = no
			# 		scope:target_country = {
			# 			NOR = {
			# 				is_country_type = unrecognized
			# 				is_country_type = decentralized
			# 			}
			# 		}
			# 	}
			# 	add = {
			# 		value = -25
			# 		desc = "STATE_VALUE_ECONOMIC_IMPERIALISM_PREFERS_TRADE"
			# 	}
			# }

			# Socialism in One Country
			# if = {
			# 	limit = {
			# 		has_strategy = ai_strategy_socialism_in_one_country
			# 		ai_state_has_core_ambition = no
			# 	}
			# 	add = {
			# 		value = -25
			# 		desc = "STATE_VALUE_SOCIALISM_IN_ONE_COUNTRY_NO_AMBITION"
			# 	}
			# }

			# Anti Imperialism
			# if = {
			# 	limit = {
			# 		has_strategy = ai_strategy_anti_imperialism
			# 		ai_state_ambition_colonial = yes
			# 	}
			# 	add = {
			# 		value = -40
			# 		desc = "STATE_VALUE_ANTI_IMPERIALISM_NO_COLONIES"
			# 	}
			# }

			# Restore Natural Borders of France
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_strategy = ai_strategy_restore_natural_borders
					ai_state_ambition_homeland = yes
				}
				add = {
					value = 35
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_RESTORE_NATURAL_BORDERS_HOMELAND"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_strategy = ai_strategy_restore_natural_borders
					ai_state_ambition_claim = yes
				}
				add = {
					value = 35
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_RESTORE_NATURAL_BORDERS_CLAIM"
				}
			}

			# if = {
			# 	limit = {
			# 		has_strategy = ai_strategy_restore_natural_borders
			# 		ai_state_ambition_border = yes
			# 		ai_state_has_core_ambition = no
			# 	}
			# 	add = {
			# 		value = -20
			# 		desc = "STATE_VALUE_RESTORE_NATURAL_BORDERS_NOT_OURS"
			# 	}
			# }

			# How much the AI actually wants this state, as opposed to how valuable the state is.
			# Every "ambition" it has adds its weight; a state it has no reason to want keeps only the floor,
			# so it is still worth something in a treaty but never worth starting a war over.
			# Placed here deliberately so that JEs can override it below.
			multiply = {
				value = ai_state_ambition_floor

				if = {
					limit = { ai_state_ambition_claim = yes }
					add = ai_state_ambition_claim_weight
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai_state_ambition_homeland = yes }
					add = ai_state_ambition_homeland_weight
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai_state_ambition_capital_region = yes }
					add = ai_state_ambition_capital_region_weight
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai_state_ambition_split_state = yes }
					add = ai_state_ambition_split_state_weight
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai_state_ambition_overlord_gift = yes }
					add = ai_state_ambition_overlord_gift_weight
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai_state_ambition_colonial = yes }
					add = ai_state_ambition_colonial_weight
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai_state_ambition_border = yes }
					add = ai_state_ambition_border_weight
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai_state_ambition_sphere = yes }
					add = ai_state_ambition_sphere_weight
				}
				if = {
					limit = { ai_state_ambition_regional_objective = yes }
					add = ai_state_ambition_regional_objective_weight
				}

				max = ai_state_ambition_max
				desc = "STATE_VALUE_AMBITION"
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								root = {
									has_technology_researched = rubber_mastication
								}
								"num_potential_resources(bt:building_rubber_plantation)" > 0
							}
							AND = {
								root = {
									has_technology_researched = pumpjacks
								}
								"num_potential_resources(bt:building_oil_rig)" > 0
							}
							"num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_field)" > 0
							"num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_mine)" > 0
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					add = 1
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_technology_researched = rubber_mastication
							"scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_rubber_plantation)" > 0
						}
						add = {
							value = "scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_rubber_plantation)"
							divide = 100
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_technology_researched = pumpjacks
							"scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_oil_rig)" > 0
						}
						add = {
							value = "scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_oil_rig)"
							divide = 100
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							"scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_field)" > 0
						}
						add = {
							value = "scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_field)"
							divide = 100
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							"scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_mine)" > 0
						}
						add = {
							value = "scope:target_state.num_potential_resources(bt:building_gold_mine)"
							divide = 100
						}
					}
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_VALUABLE_RESOURCE_POTENTIAL"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = {
						primary_cultures_percent_state = {
							target_country = root
							value >= 0.05
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					value = {
						add = 1
						add = "scope:target_state.primary_cultures_percent_state(root)"
						max = 1.5
					}
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_PRIMARY_CULTURES_PERCENT"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = { has_claim_by = root }
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 2.0
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_CLAIM"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_strategic_land_adjacency = scope:target_state }
					scope:target_state = { is_coastal = no }
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0.5
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_UNREACHABLE_INLAND"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_strategic_land_adjacency = scope:target_country
					NOT = { has_strategic_land_adjacency = scope:target_state }
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0.5
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_NOT_STRATEGICALLY_ADJACENT"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_adjacent_to_country = scope:target_country
					NOT = { is_adjacent_to_state = scope:target_state }
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0.75
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_NOT_ADJACENT_TO_STATE"
				}
			}

			# More reluctant to get involved in plays for states that AI doesn't strongly desire
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_diplomatic_play_involved_with = scope:target_country
					ai_state_has_core_ambition = no
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0.5
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_ALREADY_IN_PLAY_WEAK_DESIRE"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_state = { AND = { NOT = { has_game_rule = vl_one_culture } is_homeland_of_country_cultures = root } }
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 1.5
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_FOREIGN_HOMELAND"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_boxer_rebellion
					scope:target_state.state_region = { is_homeland = cu:han }
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_BOXER_REBELLION"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_greek_nationalism
					scope:target_state.state_region = { is_homeland = cu:greek }
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_GREEK_NATIONALISM"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_eastern_question_austria
					scope:target_state = { state_region = s:STATE_BOSNIA }
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_EASTERN_QUESTION"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_consolidate_colonial_rule
					scope:target_country = {
						is_country_type = unrecognized
						target_is_our_or_fellow_subject = no
					}
					scope:target_state = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_indian_frontier
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_CONSOLIDATE_COLONIAL_RULE"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_expanding_paraguay
					scope:target_country = {
						has_state_in_state_region = STATE_CORRIENTES
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_PARAGUAY_CORE"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_expanding_paraguay
					scope:target_country = {
						OR = {
							has_state_in_state_region = STATE_SANTA_FE
							has_state_in_state_region = STATE_PARANA
							has_state_in_state_region = STATE_RIO_GRANDE_DO_SUL
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_PARAGUAY_SECONDARY"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_age_of_princes
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							state_region = s:STATE_AMHARA
							state_region = s:STATE_GONDER
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_AGE_OF_PRINCES"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_unify_afghanistan
					scope:target_state = {
						AND = { NOT = { has_game_rule = vl_one_culture } is_homeland_of_country_cultures = root }
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 75
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_UNIFY_AFGHANISTAN"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_eastern_frontier
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_persia_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_central_asia_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_india
						}
						has_claim_by = ROOT
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 75
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_EASTERN_FRONTIER"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_manifest_destiny_mexico
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:target_state = {
							OR = {
								state_region = s:STATE_COLORADO
								state_region = s:STATE_UTAH
								state_region = s:STATE_TEXAS
								state_region = s:STATE_KANSAS
								state_region = s:STATE_OKLAHOMA
								state_region = s:STATE_ARIZONA
								state_region = s:STATE_CALIFORNIA
								state_region = s:STATE_NEVADA
								state_region = s:STATE_NEW_MEXICO
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 50
						desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_MANIFEST_DESTINY"
					}

					if = {
						limit = { is_adjacent_to_state = scope:target_state }
						multiply = {
							value = 2
							desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_MANIFEST_DESTINY_ADJACENT"
						}
					}
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_conquer_oregon
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							state_region = s:STATE_WASHINGTON
							state_region = s:STATE_IDAHO
							state_region = s:STATE_OREGON
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_CONQUER_OREGON"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_alaska
					scope:target_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_ALASKA
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_ALASKA"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_the_eastern_border
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							state_region = s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA
							state_region = s:STATE_JETISY
							state_region = s:STATE_TOMSK
							state_region = s:STATE_KIRGHIZIA
							state_region = s:STATE_AMUR
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_EASTERN_BORDER"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_conquest_of_algeria
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							state_region = s:STATE_ALGIERS
							state_region = s:STATE_CONSTANTINE
							state_region = s:STATE_ORAN
							state_region = s:STATE_SAHARA
							state_region = s:STATE_EAST_SAHARA
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 100
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_CONQUEST_OF_ALGERIA"
				}
			}

			if = { #Russian Central Asia
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_conquest_of_central_asia
					scope:target_state = {
						region = sr:region_central_asia
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 75
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_CENTRAL_ASIA"
				}
			}

			if = { #Russia wants Western borderlands
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_russification
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_finland_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_baltic_states_old
							is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_poland_old
						}
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}

			if = { # Japan wants to consolidate herself
				limit = {
					c:JAP ?= this
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom }
					scope:target_state ?= {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_japan
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JAPAN_CONSOLIDATION"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:russian
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						has_law = law_type:law_official_nationality
					}
					has_technology_researched = nationalism
					scope:target_state = {
						owner = {
							OR = {
								c:OZH ?= this
								c:UZH ?= this
								c:KZH ?= this
								c:KAZ ?= this
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_RUSSIAN_STEPPE"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					ai_russia_wants_caucasus_subject_annexed = yes
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_RUSSIAN_SUBJECT_ABSORPTION"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					ai_russia_wants_bukey_orda_annexed = yes
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_RUSSIAN_STEPPE"
				}
			}

			if = { # Russia eyes the Straits once the Eastern Question has gone her way
				limit = {
					c:RUS ?= this
					has_variable = russia_eastern_question_victory
					scope:target_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_EASTERN_THRACE
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_RUSSIAN_STRAITS"
				}
			}

			if = { # Dutch East Indies wishes to consolidate Indonesia
				limit = {
					c:DEI ?= this
					scope:target_state = {
						region = sr:region_indonesia
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_DEI_INDONESIA"
				}
			}

			# French Natural Borders
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_french_natural_borders
					OR = {
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_territorial_expansion
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_restore_natural_borders
					}
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							state_region = {
								is_homeland = cu:french
							}
							state_region = s:STATE_WALLONIA
							state_region = s:STATE_FLANDERS
							state_region = s:STATE_RHINELAND
							state_region = s:STATE_NORTH_RHINE
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_FRENCH_NATURAL_BORDERS"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					wants_to_solve_schleswig_holstein = yes
					scope:target_country = {
						is_oppressor_of_schleswig_holstein = yes
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:target_state = { state_region = s:STATE_SCHLESWIG_HOLSTEIN }
					}
					add = {
						value = 50
						desc = "STATE_VALUE_SCHLESWIG_HOLSTEIN"
					}
				}
				else = {
					multiply = {
						value = 0.0
						desc = "STATE_VALUE_SCHLESWIG_HOLSTEIN_FOCUS"
					}
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_the_krakow_uprising
					country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
					exists = c:KRA
					scope:target_state = {
						owner = { c:KRA ?= THIS }
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_KRAKOW_UPRISING"
				}
			}

			if = { # Britain wants to strengthen South Africa
				limit = {
					any_subject_or_below = {
						c:SAF ?= this
					}
					has_technology_researched = malaria_prevention
					scope:target_state = {
						region = sr:region_southern_africa
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_STRENGTHEN_SOUTH_AFRICA"
				}
			}

			if = { # Spain wants to take Al Rif
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_conquest_of_tetouan
					scope:target_state ?= {
						owner = {
							is_country_type = unrecognized
						}
						state_region = s:STATE_AL_RIF
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_CONQUEST_OF_TETOUAN"
				}
			}

			if = { # Portugal wants Gaza
				limit = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:portuguese
					has_technology_researched = malaria_prevention
					OR = {
						has_state_in_state_region = STATE_MOCAMBIQUE
						has_state_in_state_region = STATE_ZAMBEZIA
						has_state_in_state_region = STATE_LOURENCO_MARQUES
					}
					scope:target_state = {
						OR = {
							state_region = s:STATE_MOCAMBIQUE
							state_region = s:STATE_ZAMBEZIA
							state_region = s:STATE_LOURENCO_MARQUES
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_PORTUGUESE_MOZAMBIQUE"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_struggle_for_the_highveld
					scope:target_state = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_africa
						owner = {
							NOT = {
								any_primary_culture = {
									is_primary_culture_of = ROOT
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_HIGHVELD"
				}
			}

			if = { # German unification
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							OR = {
								has_journal_entry = je_north_german_unification
								has_journal_entry = je_german_unification
							}
							scope:target_country = {
								country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
								country_rank < ROOT.country_rank
								NOT = {
									is_in_same_power_bloc = ROOT
								}
							}
						}
						AND = {
							OR = {
								has_journal_entry = je_south_german_unification
								has_journal_entry = je_german_unification
							}
							scope:target_country = {
								country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
								country_rank < ROOT.country_rank
								NOT = {
									is_in_same_power_bloc = ROOT
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_risorgimento
					scope:target_country = {
						OR = {
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_italian
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_italian
						}
						country_rank < ROOT.country_rank
						NOT = {
							is_in_same_power_bloc = ROOT
						}
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_hawaiian_interest
					scope:target_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_HAWAIIAN_ISLANDS
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_HAWAII"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					lenient_ai_behavior_trigger = yes
					scope:target_state = { is_homeland_of_country_cultures = scope:target_country }
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0.0
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_LENIENT_BEHAVIOR"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_opium_wars
					scope:target_country = {
						has_variable = opium_wars_target
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_JE_OPIUM_WARS"
				}
			}

			if = { #Do Not Take core Chinese States In Full, unless another power has already done so
				limit = {
					country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
					scope:target_state = {
						owner = {
							OR = {
								c:CHI ?= this
								c:TPG ?= this
							}
						}
						OR = {
							region = sr:region_north_china
							region = sr:region_south_china
						}
					}
					OR = {
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
					}
					NOR = {
						sr:region_north_china = {
							any_scope_state = {
								NOT = { is_treaty_port = yes }
								is_largest_state_in_region = yes
								owner = {
									NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
									country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
									OR = {
										is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
										is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
										is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
									}
								}
							}
						}
						sr:region_south_china = {
							any_scope_state = {
								NOT = { is_treaty_port = yes }
								is_largest_state_in_region = yes
								owner = {
									NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
									country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
									OR = {
										is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
										is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
										is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_NO_CHINESE_CORE"
				}
			}
			# Russian Civil War
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:russian
					has_journal_entry = je_russia_civil_war
					scope:target_state = {
						owner = {
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:russian
						}
					}
				}
				add = 200
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					ai_state_is_invalid_target = yes
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_INVALID_TARGET"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_strategic_region_interest_tier = {
						strategic_region = scope:target_state.region
						value <= 1
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_NOT_INTEREST_IN_REGION"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					ai_state_is_invalid_target = no
					NOT = {
						has_strategic_region_interest_tier = {
							strategic_region = scope:target_state.region
							value <= 1
						}
					}
					NOT = { can_reach_target_state_to_conquer = { TARGET_STATE = scope:target_state } }
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0.1
					desc = "STATE_VALUE_UNREACHABLE"
				}
			}
		}

		min = {
			value = 0
			desc = "STATE_VALUE_CLAMP_MIN"
		}
		max = {
			value = 1000
			desc = "STATE_VALUE_CLAMP_OWNED"
		}
	}
}
